Senior Backend Engineer — BuildRight Client: FinanceFlow Ltd

ABOUT THE ROLE
FinanceFlow is a Series B fintech startup processing $2B+ in annual transactions.
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our platform team and help
scale our core payment processing infrastructure.

RESPONSIBILITIES
- Design and build high-throughput, low-latency microservices in Python
- Own the reliability and scalability of our PostgreSQL database layer
- Integrate with third-party payment providers (Stripe, Plaid, Adyen)
- Mentor junior engineers and contribute to architecture decisions
- Participate in on-call rotation (PagerDuty, approx. 1 week per quarter)

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
- 4+ years of professional Python backend development experience
- Strong expertise in at least one Python web framework (FastAPI preferred, Django or Flask acceptable)
- Proficiency with PostgreSQL — query optimisation, indexing, migrations
- Experience with message queues (Kafka or RabbitMQ)
- Solid understanding of REST API design and versioning
- AWS experience (EC2, RDS, Lambda, SQS)
- Track record of delivering production systems at scale (>10k req/s)
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

NICE TO HAVE
- Kubernetes / Docker orchestration experience
- Prior fintech or payments domain knowledge
- Experience with Terraform or similar IaC tooling
- BSc or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field

LOGISTICS
- Location: London, UK (hybrid — 2 days/week in office)
- Salary: £90,000 – £115,000 depending on experience
- Visa sponsorship: not available for this role
- Notice period: up to 3 months acceptable
